title: HSK 3.24 · 房租, 房东, 奶茶, 留学
focus: 节约 · 单元 · 海关 · 暖和 · 农村 · 整齐 · 志愿 · 熟人 · 功课 · 房租 · 房东 · 听力 · 结实 · 分组 · 请教 · 带动 · 华人 · 皮包 · 图画 · 绿茶 · 留学 · 教材 · 白菜 · 奶茶 · 红茶 · 人民币 · 划船 · 交费 · 凉水 · 外文 · 预习 · 连忙 · 红酒
body:
Daily life: renting a room (房租, 房东), school (功课, 预习, 教材) and drinks (绿茶, 奶茶, 红茶, 红酒). Note that 红茶 "red tea" is what English calls black tea.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 茶 | chá | tea (艹 plant on top) | 绿茶, 奶茶, 红茶 |
| 红 | hóng | red (纟 silk + 工 gōng phonetic) | 红茶, 红酒 |
| 房 | fáng | house, room (户 door + 方 fāng phonetic) | 房租, 房东 |
| 人 | rén | person | 熟人, 华人, 人民币 |
| 教 | jiào | teach | 请教, 教材 |
| 带 | dài | bring, lead | 带动 (and 带领 from earlier) |

## Watch out

- 结实 is **jiē**shi (sturdy); 结 is usually jié (结婚).
- 暖和 is nuǎnhuo: 和 reads huo, light tone, in this word.
- 熟 is shú (spoken also shóu).
- 划船 uses 划 huá (paddle); the same character is huà in 计划.

cards.Example: 我们要节约用水。 wǒmen yào jiéyuē yòng shuǐ: we should save water
cards.Notes: 节 joint, restrain + 约 restrict (纟 thread) = hold back use, save

cards.Example: 今天学第三单元。 jīntiān xué dì sān dānyuán: today we study unit 3
cards.Notes: 单 single + 元 unit, first = a single unit

cards.Example: 过海关要排队。 guò hǎiguān yào páiduì: there's a queue at customs
cards.Notes: 海 sea + 关 pass, checkpoint = sea checkpoint, customs

cards.Example: 今天很暖和。 jīntiān hěn nuǎnhuo: it's warm today
cards.Notes: 暖 warm (日 sun + 爰 phonetic) + 和 mild (here huo, light) = nice and warm

cards.Example: 他在农村长大。 tā zài nóngcūn zhǎngdà: he grew up in the countryside
cards.Notes: 农 farming + 村 village (木 tree + 寸 cùn for the sound) = farming village

cards.Example: 他的房间很整齐。 tā de fángjiān hěn zhěngqí: his room is tidy
cards.Notes: 整 whole, put in order + 齐 even = neat and orderly

cards.Example: 你的志愿是什么？ nǐ de zhìyuàn shì shénme: what's your ambition?
cards.Notes: 志 will, aim (士 + 心 heart) + 愿 wish = one's own wish, volunteer

cards.Example: 他是我的熟人。 tā shì wǒ de shúrén: he's someone I know
cards.Notes: 熟 familiar, cooked (灬 fire) + 人 person = a familiar person

cards.Example: 我在做功课。 wǒ zài zuò gōngkè: I'm doing homework
cards.Notes: 功 effort, merit (工 + 力 strength) + 课 lesson = lesson work

cards.Example: 这里房租很贵。 zhèlǐ fángzū hěn guì: rent is expensive here
cards.Notes: 房 house + 租 rent (禾 grain + 且 phonetic) = house rent

cards.Example: 房东人很好。 fángdōng rén hěn hǎo: the landlord is nice
cards.Notes: 房 house + 东 east, also 'host' (as in 东道主) = house owner

cards.Example: 我的听力不错。 wǒ de tīnglì búcuò: my listening is good
cards.Notes: 听 listen + 力 power = listening ability

cards.Example: 这个包很结实。 zhège bāo hěn jiēshi: this bag is sturdy
cards.Notes: 结 tie, knot + 实 solid = tightly knit, sturdy; reads jiē here

cards.Example: 老师给我们分组。 lǎoshī gěi wǒmen fēnzǔ: the teacher split us into groups
cards.Notes: 分 divide + 组 group (纟 + 且 phonetic) = split into groups

cards.Example: 我想请教一个问题。 wǒ xiǎng qǐngjiào yí ge wèntí: may I ask you something?
cards.Notes: 请 request + 教 teach = ask to be taught

cards.Example: 他带动了大家。 tā dàidòng le dàjiā: he got everyone going
cards.Notes: 带 lead, bring along + 动 move = get others moving

cards.Example: 这里华人很多。 zhèlǐ Huárén hěn duō: there are many Chinese people here
cards.Notes: 华 China (as in 中华) + 人 person = ethnic Chinese, anywhere in the world

cards.Example: 她买了一个皮包。 tā mǎi le yí ge píbāo: she bought a handbag
cards.Notes: 皮 skin, leather + 包 bag = leather bag

cards.Example: 墙上有一张图画。 qiáng shang yǒu yì zhāng túhuà: there's a picture on the wall
cards.Notes: 图 picture, map + 画 drawing = picture

cards.Example: 我喜欢喝绿茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē lǜchá: I like green tea
cards.Notes: 绿 green (纟 silk + 录 lù phonetic) + 茶 tea

cards.Example: 她想去美国留学。 tā xiǎng qù Měiguó liúxué: she wants to study in the US
cards.Notes: 留 stay + 学 study = stay (abroad) to study

cards.Example: 这本教材很好。 zhè běn jiàocái hěn hǎo: this textbook is good
cards.Notes: 教 teach + 材 material (木 wood + 才 cái phonetic) = teaching material

cards.Example: 今天吃白菜。 jīntiān chī báicài: we're having cabbage today
cards.Notes: 白 white + 菜 vegetable (艹 plant) = white vegetable, napa cabbage

cards.Example: 我要一杯奶茶。 wǒ yào yì bēi nǎichá: one milk tea, please
cards.Notes: 奶 milk (女 + 乃 nǎi phonetic) + 茶 tea

cards.Example: 你喝红茶吗？ nǐ hē hóngchá ma: do you drink black tea?
cards.Notes: 红 red + 茶 tea = 'red tea', called black tea in English

cards.Example: 可以用人民币吗？ kěyǐ yòng rénmínbì ma: can I pay in RMB?
cards.Notes: 人民 the people + 币 currency (巾 cloth) = the people's currency

cards.Example: 我们去湖上划船。 wǒmen qù hú shang huáchuán: let's go rowing on the lake
cards.Notes: 划 huá paddle (戈 + 刂) + 船 boat (舟 boat + phonetic) = row a boat

cards.Example: 请先交费。 qǐng xiān jiāofèi: please pay first
cards.Notes: 交 hand over + 费 fee = pay a fee

cards.Example: 别喝凉水。 bié hē liángshuǐ: don't drink cold water
cards.Notes: 凉 cool (冫 ice + 京 jīng phonetic) + 水 water; 冫 two dots, not 氵 three

cards.Example: 他会说两门外文。 tā huì shuō liǎng mén wàiwén: he speaks two foreign languages
cards.Notes: 外 outside, foreign + 文 writing, language = foreign language

cards.Example: 上课前要预习。 shàngkè qián yào yùxí: preview before class
cards.Notes: 预 in advance + 习 practice = study ahead

cards.Example: 他连忙站起来。 tā liánmáng zhàn qǐlai: he quickly stood up
cards.Notes: 连 in a row, at once + 忙 busy, hurry = hurriedly

cards.Example: 来一杯红酒吧。 lái yì bēi hóngjiǔ ba: have a glass of red wine
cards.Notes: 红 red + 酒 alcohol = red wine
